name: codex-harness-patterns
description: Long-running task patterns distilled from OpenAI Codex harness v0.149.0 — tool output budgeting, context pressure compaction, parallel sub-agent fan-out, structured plan streaming, self-review, sub-agent delegation, world-state tracking, background task management, thread-level goal persistence, and per-sub-task model routing. Activates when an agent must manage token budget, decompose work, sustain multi-step tasks without losing focus, coordinate sub-agents, or pick the right model for the job. Inspired by codex-rs/core/src/compact.rs, run_turn, Op/EventMsg protocol, InterAgentCommunication, WorldState, model-provider-info, and the models-manager sub-systems.
